missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Посёлок' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Этот' agrees in the masculine, and 'тихий' is the masculine predicate adjective.

Strategic focus: Accusative inanimate object. 'Посёлок' is the accusative object of 'посетили'; as an inanimate masculine noun its accusative matches the nominative. 'Маленький' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Посёлка' is genitive after 'возле' to mark the location nearby; note the fleeting vowel drops from 'посёлок'. 'Река' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Посёлку' is in the dative case after 'к' to show direction toward; the fleeting vowel drops. 'Дорога' is the nominative subject of 'ведёт'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Посёлком' is in the instrumental case after 'за' to mark what lies beyond; the fleeting vowel drops. 'Лес' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В посёлке' uses the prepositional form 'посёлке' after 'в', with the fleeting vowel dropping. 'Школа' is the nominative subject of 'есть'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Посёлка' is genitive modifying 'жители' to mean the settlement's residents; the fleeting vowel drops. 'Дружные' is the plural predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Посёлки' is the nominative plural subject of 'стоят'; the fleeting vowel drops before the ending. 'Небольшие' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Посёлков' is genitive plural after 'много', with the fleeting vowel retained. 'Старых' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative of destination. 'Посёлок' is the accusative after 'в' showing movement into; as inanimate it matches the nominative. 'Новый' agrees in the masculine accusative.
